scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.tsx
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.tsx CtoOdatetsuTurntable out/cto-odatetsu-turntable.mp4 --gl=angle --concurrency=2 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --muted
scripts.still: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still src/index.tsx CtoOdatetsuTurntable out/still.png --gl=angle
scripts.render-rig: npm run prepare-rig-assets && remotion render src/index.tsx RigMotionPreview out/cto-odatetsu-rig-motion.mp4 --gl=angle --concurrency=1 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --muted
scripts.still-rig: npm run prepare-rig-assets && remotion still src/index.tsx RigMotionPreview out/rig-still.png --gl=angle
scripts.rig-viewer: npm run prepare-rig-viewer && python3 -m http.server 8138 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory public
